notes: Product: WillowBend provides cloud contact center SaaS to retail + telco customers (omnichannel).
Primary ask: replace current agent-assist that uses simple keyword rules — wants streaming suggestions in the agent UI with sub-150ms p95 latency for suggestions so agents don't pause.

Key requirements: token-level streaming, tool-calling to their internal ticketing (create/update via function calls), deterministic guardrails (deny policy for PII exfiltration), and audit logs for every suggestion/action.
Latency SLOs discussed: target p50 < 50ms, p95 < 150ms for suggestion tokens on dedicated hardware; fall back to smaller quantized model if latency spikes.
Spike scenario: retail sale events can cause 6x baseline traffic. WillowBend must keep agent suggestions online; willing to pay for burst capacity but needs predictable cost model.
Security notes: must support customer-managed KMS, SSO (SAML) integration with Okta, retention controls to purge short-term transcripts after 30 days for EU accounts.
Guardrails/QA: they want inline hallucination detection + 'confidence' score and automatic safe-fallback to canned responses when model confidence < threshold.
Integration needs: webhooks for tool-calling, retry semantics, idempotency keys; deep link back to their ticket UI; streaming partial updates to agent UI.
Quote from CTO: "If we can't guarantee latency and correct tool calls during spikes, we can't justify migration."
POC plan: deploy 3 dedicated GPU nodes in private VPC, run synthetic agent traffic (mixed prompt lengths), enable prefix caching, measure token-level throughput and tail latency.
SE notes: try batching window 12ms, continuous KV cache for session history, recommend quantized fallback (int8) for cost-controlled burst handling.
Finance: expects ARR in $150k-$300k band if SLA + private deployment included. Procurement timeline: end of Q4 / early Q1 depending on POC results.
